retail_corrections.activate_pass: FElysiumEntityWorld::Activate ports ServerActivate 0x1011aaf0: for (e = NextEnt(NULL); e; e = NextEnt(e)) if (!(e->m_iEFlags & EFL_DORMANT)) e->Activate(). NextEnt 0x100f7060 re-reads each node's next link and CBaseEntityList::AddEntityAtSlot 0x100f9fc0 appends at the tail, so an entity created by an earlier Activate is activated later in the same pass (the port walks EntityList by index). The only skip is EFL_DORMANT (0x100a8220, m_iEFlags & 2), now FElysiumEntity::bEflDormant, written by camera_animated EndCamera/StartCamera (MakeDormant 0x100a8060, &= ~0x42); the globalname-owned-by-another-map arms of DispatchSpawn 0x101d1280 and the restores 0x101a2e40 / 0x101a3c40 are an empty seam: none of the 108 exported maps authors a globalname or places an env_global. EFL_KILLME is never tested: an entity killed during the pass is still activated (ActivateListedEntity); one killed before the pass is skipped, standing for retail's pre-pass delete-queue purge ("ERROR: Entity delete queue not empty"). Previously the port skipped every dead entity and activated dormant ones. Test: Elysium.Substrate.EntityWorld.ActivatePass.
